answer: Pseudonym parties: every 720 epochs, each ID's operator shows up in person at the same global hour to a local venue, a library, a community garden, a desert oasis town hall. At check-in they scan one QR cipher token encrypted to their key, renewing exactly one ID. All venues run at once, so one human can't attend two; 1,000 clones need 1,000 bodies in rooms. Proposed: 15-minute window, 2 witnesses per venue; turnout and cost per renewal not yet measured.
